title: Drosophila Natural Food Preparation
author: Wen Aw
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sdfea3n
materials: Plug bottles and allow to cool. Store 4°

steps.title: Weigh agar and add water
steps.instruction: Weigh 1 g of agar into a flask and add 100 mL of H₂O.

steps.title: Melt agar
steps.instruction: Heat the flask in a microwave until the agar is completely melted and reaches a rolling boil, watching closely to prevent boil‑over.

steps.title: Mash fruit while agar cools
steps.instruction: While the agar cools, mash approximately 100 mL of fruit in a beaker.

steps.title: Combine fruit with cooled agar
steps.instruction: When the agar is cool to the touch, add the mashed fruit to the agar and mix quickly before the agar sets.

steps.title: Add preservatives
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL propionic acid and 0.8 mL Nipigin solution to the mixture.

steps.title: Mix and aliquot
steps.instruction: Mix the entire preparation thoroughly and portion into bottles, dispensing about 10–12 mL per bottle.
